name: Shirmani Settlement Records
purpose: Define evidence-backed settlement records for completed work or exchanges without asserting that funds moved unless external payment evidence exists.

transition_rules.PENDING: Settlement candidate exists; no payment fact is established.
transition_rules.UNDER_REVIEW: Terms and evidence are being reviewed.
transition_rules.SETTLEMENT_READY: Required terms and fulfilment evidence are present; funds movement is not implied.
transition_rules.SETTLED: Actual settlement/payment evidence is present; amount must be derived from that evidence.
transition_rules.REFUNDED: Refund evidence is present; refund amount must be derived from evidence.
transition_rules.NOT_VERIFIED: Evidence is missing, contradictory, or insufficient.

integrity_rules: No fabricated payer, payee, amount, payment, refund, settlement, balance, or income.
SETTLED does not imply accounting reconciliation.
Settlement records do not execute transfers or payments.
Disputes, reversals, refunds, identity, contract interpretation and liability require human review where applicable.
AI-generated summaries are not transaction evidence by themselves.
Public income totals must be derived from evidence-backed records.
